panels.title: Response Time (ms) — overall
panels.description: avg / p90 / p95 / p99 across all samplers, from the InfluxDB Backend Listener's 'all' transaction rollup (statut=all). Field names (avg, pct90.0, etc.) are the listener's actual InfluxDB schema, confirmed by querying InfluxDB directly, not assumed.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avg") AS "avg", mean("pct90.0") AS "p90", mean("pct95.0") AS "p95", mean("pct99.0") AS "p99" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Throughput (samples/sec, approx)
panels.description: mean(count)/5, assuming the Backend Listener's default 5s flush interval (backend_influxdb.send_interval). This is a proxy for req/s, not the authoritative throughput number -- see FINAL_REPORT.md for that.

targets.query: SELECT mean("count")/5 AS "throughput" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Response Time by transaction (P95, ms)
panels.description: Per-transaction P95 -- the five named flows (01 Login .. 05 Checkout Step One). Confirms whether any one flow is disproportionately slow.

targets.query: SELECT mean("pct95.0") AS "p95" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "statut" = 'all' AND "transaction" != 'all' AND "transaction" != 'internal' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "transaction" fill(null)

panels.title: Error count (countError)
panels.description: Failed samples per flush interval, statut=all rollup. See TEST_PLAN.md section 6 before reading a nonzero value here as an application finding -- the connection-refused artifact investigated there applies to any run through this stack too.

targets.query: SELECT mean("countError") AS "errors" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

panels.title: Active threads (mean)
panels.description: From the listener's internal pseudo-transaction row (transaction=internal), field meanAT.

targets.query: SELECT mean("meanAT") AS "active_threads" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'internal' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

panels.title: Network bytes (received + sent)
panels.description: rb (received bytes) and sb (sent bytes), overall rollup, per flush interval.

targets.query: SELECT mean("rb") AS "received", mean("sb") AS "sent" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
